class A: x=7
class B: x=9
class M(type):
 def mro(cls): return [cls,B,A,object]
class C(A,B,metaclass=M): pass
print(C.x,C.__base__ is A,C.__bases__==(A,B),C.__mro__==(C,B,A,object),type.mro(C)==[C,A,B,object])

class Other: value=7
class M(type):
 def mro(cls): return [cls,Other,object]
class C(metaclass=M): pass
print(C.value,issubclass(C,Other),isinstance(C(),Other))

M=type("M",(type,),{"mro":lambda cls:(cls,object)})
C=M("C",(),{})
print(C.__mro__==(C,object))

class M(type): pass
class A(metaclass=M): pass
M.mro=lambda cls:(cls,object,object)
class B(metaclass=M): pass
print(len(A.__mro__),len(B.__mro__))
del M.mro
class C(metaclass=M): pass
print(len(C.__mro__))

class M(type):
 def mro(cls): return [cls,object,object]
class C(metaclass=M): pass
f=type.mro.__get__(C)
print(f()==[C,object],f.__self__ is C,f.__qualname__)
